plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex orchestration: ship conducts super-plan (wave-native planning with a shipped plan linter) into supervised multi-model waves on a feature branch and a reviewed PR — isolated executors judged against machine-checkable contracts; the merge stays with the user. Every link also runs standalone.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex critical review of uncommitted changes or a GitHub PR, with an optional post-review fix phase that answers and resolves the PR threads its findings came from.

plugins.name: visuals
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex visual pages: agents explain structure and show finished work as one self-contained HTML page — a verdict, one main picture and numbered decisions, or real renders and recordings with what was not verified — checked by a shipped page validator.
